allow: Reading and analyzing skill/command markdown files in this repository
Writing or editing skill, command, or plugin configuration files
Running git status, git diff, git log, and other read-only git commands
Staging and committing changes with descriptive commit messages
Searching for files and content within the repository
soft_deny: Deleting plugin directories or skill files without explicit instruction
Pushing to remote branches other than the designated feature branch
Modifying LICENSE or top-level README without explicit instruction
environment: This is the CS Ops Skills Marketplace repository for LG U+ HomCS operations
The repository contains 8 plugins with skills and commands for CS quality analysis, coaching, performance, VOC, STT, operations, reporting, and toolkit
Skills are markdown files; commands are slash-command definitions; plugins group related skills and commands
